query:
insert into ConfigReviewProperties (
                        latest_collection,
                        product_id,
                        cfg_entry,
                        property_key,
                        value_hash
                    )
                    values (
                        $1,
                        $2,
                        $3,
                        $4,
                        $5
                    )
                    on conflict (
                        product_id,
                        cfg_entry,
                        property_key
                    ) do update
                    set
                        latest_collection = excluded.latest_collection,
                        value_hash = excluded.value_hash
